Threat: Walkthroughs occurred before the OSF registration timestamp.
Mitigation: Reported explicitly as a preregistration deviation; analyses are not framed as confirmatory post-registration collection.
Residual_limitation: Temporal ordering cannot be retroactively corrected.

Threat: Member checking has documentary evidence but no audio/video recording.
Mitigation: Decision-level records, participant pseudonyms and date are preserved; no recording is fabricated.
Residual_limitation: Literal rubric requirement for restricted recording remains unmet.

Threat: Single local-gym case and non-probability recruitment.
Mitigation: Claims are restricted to FabroGym and similar small fitness-management settings.
Residual_limitation: No statistical generalization to all gyms or recommendation systems.

Threat: Only three technical and three non-technical walkthrough sessions.
Mitigation: Profile differences are reported descriptively, not inferentially.
Residual_limitation: Profile patterns require replication with larger samples.

Threat: Questionnaire was not designed as an explainability Likert instrument.
Mitigation: General ordinal questions are kept descriptive; no explainability satisfaction scale is constructed.
Residual_limitation: Perceived explainability cannot be quantified from this questionnaire.

Threat: Explainability labels are multi-label and no closed denominator for the full framework was preregistered.
Mitigation: Observed dimensions are reported as frequencies only; no fabricated coverage percentage.

Threat: Code-level saturation criterion is 6.306%, above the <=5% threshold.
Mitigation: The exact value is reported; axial stabilization at 1.852% is complementary only.
Residual_limitation: Strict code saturation is not claimed.

Threat: No quantitative per-participant outcome supports Mann-Whitney, Fleiss kappa, Shapiro-Wilk or Levene.
Mitigation: Non-applicability is documented and no inferential p-values are produced.
Residual_limitation: Inference about group differences is unavailable.
